purpose: Recover a stable-identity, all-position, leakage-safe pregame availability history for the 2025 NFL season without using postgame participation or completed-2026 outcomes.

amendment_record.reason: The first collection run failed before any FootballDB rows were observed because direct FootballDB HTTP returned 403 to the GitHub-hosted runner.
changes: Replace direct regular-season FootballDB HTTP collection with an immutable GitHub mirror generated by the same public FootballDB scraper.
Use official NFL.com historical pages for postseason cross-checking.
Use the NFL Personnel (Injury) Report Policy game-status filing day, conservatively treated as 23:59:59 America/New_York, as chronology proof for the final pregame practice/report state.

amendment_record.reason: The second collection run failed before cross-source reconstruction because the immutable FootballDB mirror contains 2025 weeks 1-12 only, not weeks 13-18. No agreement, qualification, or model result was observed.
changes: Promote official NFL.com historical injury pages to the primary all-season cross-check for regular weeks 1-18 and postseason weeks 19-22.
Retain the immutable FootballDB mirror as supplemental dated corroboration only for the 2025 weeks it actually contains; it is no longer a completeness dependency.
Require all 22 official NFL historical pages instead of requiring 18 FootballDB mirror weeks.

nflverse_injuries_2025.role: stable GSIS identity plus all-position weekly official-report state for weeks 1-22

nfl_com_historical_pages.role: official all-position player/injury/final-practice/game-status cross-check for every 2025 NFL week; raw HTML is content-addressed and retained

footballdb_regular_mirror.role: supplemental immutable day-by-day corroboration where present; never a completeness dependency

nfl_reporting_policy.role: official chronology rule establishing when the final practice/game-status report is required before each game

nflverse_schedule.role: authoritative game identity and kickoff clock for conservative T-120 proof

chronology_policy.conservative_known_time: Derive the required Game Status Report day from NFL policy and the scheduled game weekday. Treat the report as known only at 23:59:59 America/New_York on the required filing day, deliberately later than the normal 4:00 p.m. deadline. A row passes chronology only if that timestamp is <= kickoff minus 120 minutes.
chronology_policy.late_revision_policy: Final game designations may change after the initial report. Therefore report_status is retained and cross-checked but is not authorized as a historical model input by this reconstruction. Injury listing and final practice status are the historical availability state targeted for qualification.
chronology_policy.cross_source_policy: NFL.com practice-status disagreement or ambiguous stable identity is not silently resolved. Such rows remain unresolved until independently corroborated by dated pregame evidence.

identity_policy.nfl_com_crosswalk: Within season/week/team, prefer exact normalized full name to a unique nflverse GSIS row; use first-initial plus surname only as a deterministic unique fallback. Ambiguous keys remain unresolved; no fuzzy one-to-many guessing is allowed.

failure_policy: Raw sources and diagnostics may be persisted when a gate fails, but no failed or unresolved row is authorized for probability-model training. Numeric thresholds may not be relaxed in response to observed 2025 reconstruction results; remaining rows must instead be resolved with independent dated pregame evidence or remain explicitly unknown.
